counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.016455... to 0.005 (single field) - finer integration restores right-boundary collision/positional correction so body remains inside arena for all 194 steps

explanation: Shrunk scenario: single body sliding off a platform (wall 8.8,9,6.3x0.4) falls and bounces on floor (e=0.2 loses ~88J at step 188), then travels right at vx~2.72 m/s toward the implicit right boundary (x=20). With dt=0.016455 (2-3 substeps near impact), the boundary collision never produces a rebound: vx stays 2.717 from step 188 onward, and the body drifts incrementally beyond the arena each step (overshoot -0.0007 at step 190, +0.044 at 191, +0.088 at 192, +0.133 at 193, +0.178 at 194) violating the 0.15 limit at step 194. Reducing dt to 0.005 restores correct boundary handling and eliminates the violation, indicating a dt/substep-dependent failure to detect/correct the right-wall collision.
vision_note: The red circle at the bottom-right corner moves steadily to the right and increasingly protrudes through the black right boundary instead of rebounding into the arena. From step 191 to step 194 the overlap grows each frame, and by step 194 most of the body is outside the arena.
